notes.title: CHROME SWEAT Devlog #002
notes.content:
Levels, levels, levels!

Level building has proven to be the most time consuming part (so far) in CHROME SWEAT's development process. As a result, I've been putting a ton of effort into that space as of recent. Since each level supports different playstyles and different strategic options, it does increase the total development time. Fortunately, good progress has been made so far.


As always, thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: CHROME SWEAT Devlog #001
notes.content:
Progress has been made in the following areas:
-Level building
-Implementing character customization
-Quests/Writing
-Weapon implementation

Not a particularly exciting devlog but, just wanted to give a quick update!
